svg.aria-label: A correctly classified digit 8, original dataset index 1069, and its first-layer responses. Top: eight trained kernels with one symmetric color scale. Bottom: eight ReLU feature maps with one nonnegative scale. Input intensity is 0–1; channel indices are 0–7.
